headline: Last session: Sensex drops 571 points as Nifty logs eighth consecutive weekly decline in record bear run

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Sensex dropped 570.59 points and Nifty tanked to 22,421.95 during the last trading session.
Indian benchmark shares posted their eighth weekly decline in a row, marking the longest weekly losing run in 25 years.
NSE-listed companies faced significant market capitalization erosion amounting to trillions of rupees during the sell-off.
Sectoral indices like Nifty Auto slipped 3%, adding pressure to the broader market.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty extended their losing streak to eight straight weeks amid continued market decline.
Jio is reportedly planning its IPO by October end at an enterprise valuation above ₹12 trillion.
Automakers and appliance makers are boosting production and dealer stocks to meet expected festive demand.
Market outlook for the week of 5 to 9 October 2026 suggests volatile trading driven by FII selling.
summary:
In the last session, Indian benchmark indices extended their losing streak to an eighth consecutive week, with the Sensex dropping over 570 points and Nifty falling to 22,422.
Investors faced massive market capitalization erosion as broad-based selling dragged down major sectoral indices like Nifty Auto.
Meanwhile, Jio is preparing for an IPO targeted for late October at an estimated valuation of over ₹12 trillion.
